title: Fort Témiscamingue Dairy and Icehouse

terrainReference.basis: Original present-day terrain beside the estimated western threshold.

mapIdentity.provider: Parks Canada archaeological site inventory and mapped trading-post context
mapIdentity.scope: The Parks Canada inventory places the dairy east of the factor’s house. The historic group is estimated 19 m east and 3 m south of the house’s center.

note: Parks Canada identifies a dairy and icehouse, and its field report records an excavated icehouse. The reconstruction is a low timber structure with a stone base, a main storage chamber and attached service section. The exact plan and finish are estimates.
